name: Pencil Plus: The Wrath of The Spankster
source:
In Pencil Plus: The Wrath of the Spankster, you play as Conner, a high school student who gains the extraordinary power to pull unlimited pencils out of his pockets. But this power is not just for show - Conner must use it to stop The Spankster, another student who has gained the ability to spank people with no consequences, except for the shame and laughter of those around them.

As you navigate the halls of the high school, you'll encounter a cast of colorful characters and make choices that determine the course of the story. Will you be able to stop The Spankster and restore peace to the school? It's up to you to decide.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2291980/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在《Pencil Plus: The Wrath of The Spankster》中，你将扮演高中生Conner。他获得了一种非凡的超能力：可以从口袋中取出无穷无尽的铅笔。但这份能力可不只是用来炫耀的——Conner必须用它阻止另一名学生“拍屁股怪”。对方也得到了超能力：可以随意拍别人的屁股，完全不必承担后果，只会给被拍的人留下羞耻，以及旁人的笑声。

穿行在高中的走廊里，你会遇见一群个性鲜明的角色，并通过选择决定故事的走向。你能阻止拍屁股怪，让学校恢复和平吗？一切由你决定。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2291980/]Steam[/url]]
